map.上传图片，智能提取主色调，生成调色板并导出为 CSS / JSON: Upload an image and extract its dominant colours with the median-cut algorithm, then edit and export the palette as CSS or JSON.
map.中位切分：在 RGB 空间沿像素分布最长的颜色轴递归取中位分割，直至达到目标色数: Median cut: recursively split along the longest colour axis of the pixel distribution in RGB space, until the target colour count k is reached
map.基于中位切分（median-cut）色彩量化：反复沿最长颜色轴中位切分，得到 k: Median-cut colour quantization: repeatedly split along the longest colour axis to get k representative colours, preserving the image's main tones better than averaging; editable and exportable as CSS or JSON.
